iacultivada.titulo: Cultivated AI: why your AI keeps making the same mistake

inicio.kicker: Course · 8 lessons · personal, Jarvis, and company
inicio.titulo: Cultivated AI: stop repeating the same correction and make your agent get better every week
inicio.lead: The model arrives ready-made, and it's the same one your competitor has. What improves is the garden around it: role, context, rules, examples, memory, evaluation, and feedback. In eight lessons you build the five files that cultivate, close the loop with the failure log, and decide the agent's autonomy by the numbers.
inicio.capa_alt: Cultivated AI: a greenhouse with seedlings growing and threads of digital light at the roots.

numeros.t: levels of autonomy, raised by evidence

inicio.aulas_sub: Concept, the files, three gardens (personal life, Jarvis, and company), the evaluation cycle, and autonomy by evidence. Each lesson has a practice with "done when" and a commented test.

itens: People who use AI every day and are tired of explaining the same thing every week.
People who built (or want to build) a personal assistant, a Jarvis, and expect it to improve.
Managers who are about to put the first agent into a company process.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Describe any agent through the eight elements and write its agent profile.
Keep a failure log and a weekly review: the correction goes into the file, not into the chat.
Measure accuracy by sampling and decide whether to raise or lower autonomy using numbers.
Leave with a dated plan for 30 days (personal) or 90 days (company).
